description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928, known for burgers made with 100% fresh Canadian beef and locally sourced ingredients including BC chicken and BC-grown potatoes. The New Westminster location on Sixth Street offers full table-service dining as well as a patio, curbside pickup, and third-party delivery. Touring cyclists will find a familiar, family-friendly stop with a broad menu and vegetarian options.
